scenarios.name: Bull
assumptions: Cloud hyperscalers increase 2027 AI capex budgets by 35%+, absorbing maximum Blackwell and Vera Rubin GB300 allocations.
Sovereign AI initiatives and enterprise agentic reasoning drive non-hyperscaler Data Center revenue to 35%+ of mix.
System-level rack architectures (NVLink Switch, liquid-cooled compute trays) sustain gross margins at 76.5%.

scenarios.name: Base
assumptions: Q3 guidance of $108B is exceeded with full fiscal 2027 revenue crossing $425B.
Blackwell Ultra transitions smoothly into early Rubin volume production with supply constraints easing gradually.
Hyperscaler custom ASICs capture ~15-20% of specialized inference workloads without disrupting core frontier model training.

scenarios.name: Bear
assumptions: Cloud providers enter a multi-quarter capacity digestion phase as AI monetization payback periods extend.
Custom hyperscaler silicon (Google TPU v6, Meta MTIA, AWS Trainium) displaces NVIDIA GPUs in high-volume inference.
Increased HBM4 packaging costs and secondary market supply push operating margins down to 55%.
